scope: Research reset and an executable go/no-go decision. Not a new-life claim, not 640 more random worlds, and not a modification to old M6/M7 research laws.
questions: Does unchanged master physics represent a material variable capable of structural inheritance and a microscopic reaction whose conditional rate reads that variable, beyond species/energy/valence/local catalyst species?

Can native original physics transform a spatially organized parent into a physically disjoint child with a corresponding causal heritable configuration (not a duplicated visualization/detector inference)?
Which least-biased new law would make that possibility testable, and which placebo removes its information channel while leaving resources and rates comparable?

verification.simulation: On unchanged master original configs/m2_quick.json, 12 fixed fresh numerical seeds 41001–41012, advance 40 native ticks each; assert exact original persistent particle ID tuple AND type tuple and count unchanged; verify full world invariants. This is an implementation capability audit, NOT a proof of impossible emergent structural replication.
verification.source_and_schema: Read frozen native source AST using the standard library and verify immutable SpeciesConfig schema fields; original _candidate_pairs and _catalysis_factor explicit inputs: species, energy, valence, local contacts; read existing chemical reactions and species/types; source hash each. Missing explicit heritable marker or sequence template machinery is an engineering fact, NOT a theorem ruling out unimplemented emergence.
verification.selfcontained_controls: Implement deterministic detector calibration with synthetically supplied event traces: a designed 3-generation directed disjoint-material positive reference, a negative with only same-shape events but no causal parent ID linkage, a negative with shared material IDs, a negative of only a first generation, and a parent-mutated but child-unaffected negative. These are CALIBRATIONS not emergent simulation outcomes.

decision_gate.keep_M7_original_physics_for_structural_: If old law audit finds no explicit sequence/templating heredity channel and no observed causal transfer of sequence to a separate material product, mark M7 as COMPLETED FOR PASSIVE CHEMISTRY and STOP additional topology, edge, or energy-only Monte Carlo sweeps unless a specific counterexample hypothesis is preregistered.
decision_gate.start_M8_new_physics_sandbox: Allow ONLY an explicit separately versioned proposed microscopic, local information-transfer reaction law (e.g. species sequence-dependent template-assisted monomer attachment) with no hardcoded organism, genome or pre-seeded template replicator, tested separately against rate-matched shuffled-template and no-template physical controls.
M8_preflight_acceptance: All material and energy mass ledgers explicit, consumed monomer stock and reaction/dissipation budgets; stationary parent alone is not called life.
Natural unbiased assembly of sequence-bearing candidate structures from raw monomers WITHOUT injecting a prebuilt organism; distinguish artificial synthetic positive control.
At least one real sequence-dependent change in child product caused by a parent material sequence edit while keeping external substrate/energy/chemical random draws matched.

Distinct persistent parent/child material-ID sets, verified temporal causal order and structural independence, no pre-coded Copy() instruction; first and second generation events are NOT counted as independent seed-worlds.
Negative controls: shuffled parent sequence identity, same resource/rate with channel disabled, pseudo-parent of same species/material size without coherent sequence, and unpowered control.

Minimum 3 successive unforced informational generations before claims of inheritance; explicit noise/mutation/noise-resilience measurement; hold-out new seeds and preregistered threshold before examining outcome.
stop_conditions: If independent false-positive control is classified as inherited information, STOP and fix detector BEFORE running science.
If candidate mechanism cannot produce the intended positive control on closed microscopic test, STOP and revise rules explicitly, not search more seeds.

If positive and rate-matched shuffled controls are indistinguishable after preregistered sufficient information-bearing events, STOP that mechanism and document negative result; do NOT add energy sources or catalysis without a new protocol.
decision_gate.language: All successful synthetic detector tests are CODE CORRECTNESS only; all native M7 observations are chemical structure persistence, not synthetic life. No unsupported claim that fixed particle count makes copying of a pattern impossible.
